008package utils;
009
010import java.io.*;
011import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
012import java.nio.file.*;
013import javax.xml.parsers.*;
014import org.w3c.dom.*;
015
016/**
017 * ===============================================================
018 *  POM REFORMATTER UTILITY (TRUE STRUCTURAL INDENTATION)
019 * ===============================================================
020 * PURPOSE:
021 *   - 4-space indentation with correct nesting
022 *   - Remove blank/whitespace-only lines
023 *   - Add one blank line before a comment block
024 *   - Add one blank line after </dependency> and </repository>
025 * <p>
026 * AUTHOR: Herr Doctor
027 * MODULE: paint-development-utils
028 * UPDATED: 2025-11-05
029 * ===============================================================
030 */
031public class ReformatPoms {
032
033    private static final File ROOT_DIR =
034            new File("/Users/hans/JavaPaintProjects/Glyco-PAINT-Java");
035
036    public static void main(String[] args) {
037        System.out.println("🔍 Searching for pom.xml files under: " + ROOT_DIR.getAbsolutePath());
038        reformatAllPoms(ROOT_DIR);
039        System.out.println("✨ All POMs processed.");
040    }
041
042    private static void reformatAllPoms(File dir) {
043        if (dir == null || !dir.exists()) return;
044        File[] files = dir.listFiles();
045        if (files == null) return;
046        for (File f : files) {
047            if (f.isDirectory()) reformatAllPoms(f);
048            else if ("pom.xml".equalsIgnoreCase(f.getName())) reformatPom(f);
049        }
050    }
051
052    private static void reformatPom(File pomFile) {
053        try {
054            String original = new String(Files.readAllBytes(pomFile.toPath()), StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
055
056            // Parse DOM, preserving comments
057            DocumentBuilderFactory dbf = DocumentBuilderFactory.newInstance();
058            dbf.setIgnoringComments(false);
059            dbf.setNamespaceAware(true);
060            DocumentBuilder db = dbf.newDocumentBuilder();
061            Document doc = db.parse(new ByteArrayInputStream(original.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));
062            doc.normalizeDocument();
063
064            // Build formatted XML manually
065            StringBuilder xml = new StringBuilder();
066            xml.append("<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\" standalone=\"no\"?>\n");
067            formatNode(doc.getDocumentElement(), xml, 0);
068
069            // Clean up spacing rules
070            String cleaned = removeBlankLines(xml.toString());
071            String withComments = addBlankBeforeCommentBlocks(cleaned);
072            String withBlocks = addBlankAfterClosingTags(withComments);
073
074            Files.write(pomFile.toPath(), withBlocks.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
075            System.out.println("✅ Reformatted: " + pomFile.getAbsolutePath());
076        } catch (Exception e) {
077            System.err.println("❌ Error reformatting " + pomFile.getAbsolutePath() + ": " + e.getMessage());
078        }
079    }
080
081    /** Recursive XML printer with inline text for simple values and 4-space nesting. */
082    private static void formatNode(Node node, StringBuilder out, int level) {
083        String indent = " ".repeat(level * 4);
084
085        switch (node.getNodeType()) {
086            case Node.ELEMENT_NODE:
087                out.append(indent).append("<").append(node.getNodeName());
088
089                // Write attributes inline
090                NamedNodeMap attrs = node.getAttributes();
091                for (int i = 0; i < attrs.getLength(); i++) {
092                    Node a = attrs.item(i);
093                    out.append(" ").append(a.getNodeName()).append("=\"")
094                            .append(a.getNodeValue()).append("\"");
095                }
096
097                NodeList children = node.getChildNodes();
098                if (children.getLength() == 0) {
099                    out.append("/>\n");
100                    return;
101                }
102
103                // If only one text node
104                if (children.getLength() == 1 && children.item(0).getNodeType() == Node.TEXT_NODE) {
105                    String text = children.item(0).getTextContent().trim();
106                    if (text.contains("\n") || text.length() > 80) {
107                        // multiline or long text -> block format
108                        out.append(">\n")
109                                .append(indent).append("    ").append(text).append("\n")
110                                .append(indent).append("</").append(node.getNodeName()).append(">\n");
111                    } else {
112                        // short -> inline
113                        out.append(">").append(text)
114                                .append("</").append(node.getNodeName()).append(">\n");
115                    }
116                    return;
117                }
118
119                // Otherwise recurse for child elements
120                out.append(">\n");
121                for (int i = 0; i < children.getLength(); i++) {
122                    Node child = children.item(i);
123                    if (child.getNodeType() == Node.TEXT_NODE &&
124                            child.getTextContent().trim().isEmpty())
125                        continue; // skip whitespace text
126                    formatNode(child, out, level + 1);
127                }
128                out.append(indent).append("</").append(node.getNodeName()).append(">\n");
129                break;
130
131            case Node.COMMENT_NODE:
132                out.append(indent).append("<!-- ").append(node.getNodeValue().trim()).append(" -->\n");
133                break;
134
135            default:
136                break;
137        }
138    }
139    private static String removeBlankLines(String text) {
140        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
141        try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new StringReader(text))) {
142            String line;
143            while ((line = br.readLine()) != null)
144                if (!line.trim().isEmpty()) sb.append(line).append("\n");
145        } catch (IOException ignore) {}
146        return sb.toString();
147    }
148
149    /** Add one blank line before a comment block, not inside or after. */
150    private static String addBlankBeforeCommentBlocks(String text) {
151        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
152        String[] lines = text.split("\\r?\\n");
153        boolean prevIsComment = false;
154        for (String line : lines) {
155            boolean isComment = line.trim().startsWith("<!--");
156            if (isComment && !prevIsComment) sb.append("\n"); // before block
157            sb.append(line).append("\n");
158            prevIsComment = isComment;
159        }
160        return sb.toString().replaceAll("(?m)\\n{3,}", "\n\n");
161    }
162
163    /** Adds one blank line after </dependency> and </repository>. */
164    private static String addBlankAfterClosingTags(String text) {
165        text = text.replaceAll("(?m)</dependency>\\r?\\n(?!\\r?\\n)", "</dependency>\n\n");
166        text = text.replaceAll("(?m)</repository>\\r?\\n(?!\\r?\\n)", "</repository>\n\n");
167        text = text.replaceAll("(?m)(</dependency>|</repository>)\\r?\\n{3,}", "$1\n\n");
168        return text;
169    }
170
171}
